headline: Denied. A block rule applies: “Tool schema changed since it was approved”.

who.name: Mark
who.text: Mark, in the group travel-agents, with the scope tools:invoke. Signed in with a mock sign-in (persona).

asked.attendedText: attended: Mark made the call directly (the token has no agent)
asked.text: book_fare (booking app), amount 500. Attended: Mark made the call directly. Approvals so far: 0. Tool schema: changed since it was approved.

why: The rule “Tool schema changed since it was approved” (s05-rugpull-pin) says: Blocks any call to any tool when the tool's description or schema has changed since it was approved. This request fits it, so it is blocked, even though “Travel agents may book fares” (s23-permit-travel-agents) would have allowed it. A block rule always beats an allow rule.

decidedBy.reason: Tool schema changed since it was approved
decidedBy.does: Blocks any call to any tool when the tool's description or schema has changed since it was approved.

rules.reason: Tool schema changed since it was approved
because: the tool's description or schema changed since it was approved
rules.oneLine: Blocks any call to any tool when the tool's description or schema has changed since it was approved.

rules.statusText: Would have allowed it, but a block rule beat it
rules.oneLine: Lets people in the travel-agents group make calls (attended or unattended) to tools in the booking app.

rules.reason: Fares over 1000 need a second pair of eyes
because: the call is attended, and this rule only covers unattended calls (an agent acting for someone)
rules.oneLine: Holds unattended calls to the book_fare tool when an amount is given and the amount is over 1000, until Priya approves. It stops applying once someone has approved the call.

rules.reason: Hard cap: no booking over 10000 for anyone
rules.oneLine: Blocks calls (attended or unattended) to the book_fare tool when an amount is given and the amount is over 10000.

rules.reason: Analysts may use Search and Ticketing
because: this rule is about the search and ticketing apps, not the booking app
rules.oneLine: Lets people in the analysts group make attended calls to tools in the search or ticketing app.

rules.reason: Payments is for finance, with the payments:write scope
because: this rule is about the payments app, not the booking app
rules.oneLine: Lets people in the finance group make attended calls to tools in the payments app when the token has the payments:write scope.

change.text: No approver is named for “Tool schema changed since it was approved” (s05-rugpull-pin), so an approval cannot lift it. “Tool schema changed since it was approved” (s05-rugpull-pin) would stop applying if the tool matched the approved version again, and the call would then be allowed.

items.text: the tool matched the approved version again

technical.reason: Tool schema changed since it was approved
